authority_scope: Atlas phase 2 working branch only; not EA controlled corpus
purpose: Versioned vocabulary for clear, source-grounded item and conceptual-node documentation.

etiquetas.definition: A concrete mechanism for locating and re-evaluating the referenced object: a resolvable URI or identifier, an internal locator, and an observed state or revision.
constraints: Do not invent a hash or revision.
Do not publish sensitive identifiers.
An unreachable link is not evidence.

etiquetas.definition: A self-contained natural-language description of the object, retaining distinctions, negations, conditions and provenance that discrete tags cannot express.
constraints: Do not replace the description with a tag list.
Do not infer claims unsupported by the source.

etiquetas.definition: Explicit references to anchored items stating each source's evidential role. Referencing a source does not imply that it supports every property of the record.
constraints: Reference existing IDs.
Retain each source's role as support, refutation, analogy, hypothesis or other documented use.

etiquetas.definition: Version of the Atlas record, distinct from the source revision and dictionary version.
constraints: Do not confuse record version with source_revision.

etiquetas.definition: Evidence or review state of a record, such as documented source, synthetic hypothesis, candidate or pending anchor. This is distinct from situated A/B/C/D assessment.
constraints: Do not turn a hypothesis into an implemented result.
This status is distinct from A/B/C/D.

etiquetas.definition: Kind of referable object, such as a document, fragment, website, software, person, company, field case or explicitly synthetic artefact.
constraints: Do not confuse the referable object with the conceptual node record.

etiquetas.definition: The function of a node in its documented textual interpretation; this is not an exhaustive ontological class.
constraints: Do not assign global A/B/C/D or Jumps & Falls roles.
Anchor concrete claims.

etiquetas.definition: How something operates where a mechanism is described. Missing or uncertain mechanisms remain identifiable rather than being filled by invention.
constraints: Do not invent causality.
A mechanism is optional when the object has none documented.

etiquetas.definition: The node's descriptive domain and conditions of applicability, distinct from the scope declared for a situated walk.
constraints: This does not replace the scope of a situated position.

etiquetas.definition: An explicit difference from neighbouring ideas that prevents conflating nodes or attributing a container's properties to one of its parts.
etiquetas.example: Focus ON no equivale al framework JUBAP completo.
constraints: Retain meaningful negations present in the source.

etiquetas.definition: An observable signal or result and its interpretation, without treating observation alone as causal validation.
constraints: Keep an objective, an indicator and a demonstrated result distinct.

etiquetas.definition: An explicit condition or assumption of the node; a local condition remains tied to its stated setting.
constraints: Retain whether a condition is observed, assumed or hypothetical.

etiquetas.definition: The conceptual verb or relation making an edge intelligible, such as includes, uses, contributes to, contradicts or is articulated with.
constraints: Do not reduce every relation to merely related.
Do not turn a conceptual relation into causal certainty.

etiquetas.definition: Optional reusable classification of a relation predicate without replacing its full natural-language meaning.
constraints: A relation type does not determine A/B/C/D.

etiquetas.definition: Level-1 predicate orientation: directed, symmetric or permitting a defined semantic inverse.
constraints: A defined inverse such as includes/belongs-to is permitted.
Do not infer reverse causality.

etiquetas.definition: The specific reason two nodes are connected, supported by a source or identified as interpretation or hypothesis.
constraints: Lexical similarity alone is insufficient.

etiquetas.definition: Starting node from which the complete accumulated prefix of a situated walk is assessed.
constraints: Do not confuse the walk's origin with an edge's evidential source.

etiquetas.definition: The declared activity, process or use determining which functions and boundaries matter for a walk.
constraints: Do not replace the declared activity with a thematic label.

etiquetas.definition: The concrete exploration or decision question whose evaluability is being assessed.
constraints: Do not generalise A/B/C/D without a question.

etiquetas.definition: The methods, access, authority, resources and time actually available for assessing the question, especially when distinguishing C from D.
constraints: D requires an effective evaluation boundary, not mere lack of knowledge.

etiquetas.definition: A step's epistemic role relative to the full preceding path and declared position, assessed before Jumps & Falls.
constraints: Do not fix this assessment globally on an edge.
D terminates that route.
Do not confuse ABCD.C with MSCA.C.

etiquetas.definition: Jumps & Falls functions fulfilled by a step in its declared activity, assessed after A/B/C/D. The list may be empty.
constraints: JF.F4 is distinct from D.
Do not use factors from another F-series.
All four roles are not mandatory.

etiquetas.definition: The actual reason a walk stops: D, lack of relevance, budget, cycle, end of graph or pending review.
constraints: A budget-limited stop is not D.

etiquetas.definition: Nodes reached through justified contextual A assessments from declared positions, used to identify a functional conceptual core.
constraints: This is not universal centrality.
Use only justified contextual A routes.

etiquetas.definition: Discourses, questions and clusters made readable by a differentiated thematic axis, distinct from a tag's scope or a route's scope.
constraints: Propose themes after examining clusters.

etiquetas.definition: A meaningful difference from neighbouring themes that prevents redundant reading axes.
constraints: Do not invent separation between connected clusters.

etiquetas.definition: Editorial relevance weight of a node under a theme, with a justified primary association of weight 1 and lower secondary weights.
constraints: A relevance weight is not a probability of truth.
Do not assign every theme to every node.

etiquetas.definition: Optional MSCA analysis profile for an explicitly situated control question; it does not impose an MSCA form on every node.
constraints: MSCA is an optional situated profile.
Do not transfer Atlas A/B/C/D into MSCA sufficiency or execution authority.

etiquetas.definition: The concrete question that this thought unit answers for a reader.
etiquetas.distinction: Describes the explanatory purpose of a node; it does not replace a situated walk's decision question.
etiquetas.example: What is the difference between a program's input grammar and the inputs on which it actually halts?
etiquetas.author: Atlas node documentation review
constraints: Use only when it adds supported explanatory information.
Retain the difference between source claims, editorial explanation and constructed examples.
etiquetas.counterexample: Repeating the node title or adding the same generic text to every card.

etiquetas.definition: Formal expressions belonging to a node, with notation, units or reference conventions and located sources where applicable.
etiquetas.distinction: Records the formulation itself; node:mechanism describes operation in prose. The expression is stored once in the reserved field.

notation.meaning: algorithmic description length of state x

etiquetas.author: Atlas node documentation review
constraints: Use only when it adds supported explanatory information.
Retain the difference between source claims, editorial explanation and constructed examples.
etiquetas.counterexample: Repeating the node title or adding the same generic text to every card.

etiquetas.definition: A concrete worked example that makes the thought understandable, identifying whether it is source-reported or constructed for explanation.
etiquetas.distinction: An illustration is not an observed outcome. node:observable describes what can be measured rather than supplying a worked example.

example.situation: A universe has eight equiprobable states.

etiquetas.author: Atlas node documentation review
constraints: Use only when it adds supported explanatory information.
Retain the difference between source claims, editorial explanation and constructed examples.
etiquetas.counterexample: Repeating the node title or adding the same generic text to every card.

etiquetas.definition: An ordered explanatory chain from premises or definitions to a stated result, identifying algebraic reasoning and any additional assumptions.
etiquetas.distinction: A derivation explains why a result follows. node:mechanism explains how a process operates; neither substitutes for the other.
example: Subtract the initial and final definitions to obtain ΔE=−ΔH.
etiquetas.author: Atlas node documentation review
constraints: Use only when it adds supported explanatory information.
Retain the difference between source claims, editorial explanation and constructed examples.
etiquetas.counterexample: Repeating the node title or adding the same generic text to every card.

etiquetas.definition: Local meanings of the technical terms or symbols a reader needs to understand this node, with source-specific meanings retained.
etiquetas.distinction: Defines vocabulary within the card. It does not create a global theme or equate similarly named quantities across manuscripts.

example.meaning: The inputs on which the specified machine eventually terminates.

etiquetas.author: Atlas node documentation review
constraints: Use only when it adds supported explanatory information.
Retain the difference between source claims, editorial explanation and constructed examples.
etiquetas.counterexample: Repeating the node title or adding the same generic text to every card.

etiquetas.definition: A specific way the idea, model, application or interpretation can fail, together with the condition that makes that failure relevant.
etiquetas.distinction: A failure mode describes an identified breakdown. node:condition states a prerequisite; this tag is not a mandatory disclaimer.
etiquetas.example: Reading a stationary solution as stable without checking the sign of the local derivative can reverse the predicted dynamics.
etiquetas.author: Atlas node documentation review
constraints: Use only when it adds supported explanatory information.
Retain the difference between source claims, editorial explanation and constructed examples.
etiquetas.counterexample: Repeating the node title or adding the same generic text to every card.

ABCD.authority: EA/EP 00M v0.8 §1 — adopted semantics; reused here without modification
ABCD.scope: walk step relative to whole prefix and position

A.rule: function or result actually used/delivered by declared process

B.rule: assessable option with method and conditions, not necessarily used

C.rule: grounded relevant avenue not yet characterized for defensible evaluation

D.es: residual más allá de evaluación efectiva
D.rule: potentially material influence beyond current effective assessment

UNKNOWN.rule: not an ABCD value; do not manufacture a classification

JF.authority: Jumps & Falls research framing; separate from JUBAP and FG-TIDA F-series
JF.scope: functional overlay on an assessed walk step, after ABCD

JF.F2.role: transformation mechanism and its feasible effort

JF.F3.role: declared or observed outcome and value

JF.F4.role: direct or indirect effects outside primary chain; parallel and transversal

notes: F1→F2→F3 functional chain; F4 is not mandatory fourth step
Jump/Walk/Fall outcomes are not factor numbers

governance.review_policy: Bots may propose and locally use provisional labels; publication as shared dictionary key requires explicit review of meaning, examples and aliases.

extension_review.shared_canonical_status: New proposed keys are explicitly identified; controlled research definitions remain unchanged.
extension_review.rationale: Source anchoring and a valid JSON shape do not by themselves explain a thought. The added entries distinguish a question, formulation, terminology, worked example, derivation and specific failure mode.
